links.outcome: Readability and patient-rated comprehension of original vs ChatGPT-simplified radiology reports
links.effect: FRE 51.1 (original) vs 55.0 and 56.4 (simplified), P<.001; ability to understand findings without help: mean 1.5 (SD 0.7) text 3 vs 3.1 (SD 1.4) text 1.
links.quote: Both simplified report versions (texts 2 and 3) received significantly better ratings across all evaluated aspects, highlighting a preference for more accessible medical documents in the future.
